d: Gulf Laboratories, part of Mannai Corporation, provides specialized laboratory testing, inspection, and analytical services in Qatar. The laboratory supports various industries through transformer oil testing, lubricant oil analysis, electrical condition assessments, and quality assurance services, with a focus on accurate results, technical reliability, and compliance with international testing standards.
We are seeking an experienced Electrical Engineer – Transformer Oil & Lubricant Oil Testing to join Gulf Laboratories in Doha.

The role involves managing and conducting transformer oil and lubricant oil testing, electrical condition assessments, laboratory operations, and technical report interpretation. The ideal candidate should have strong hands-on experience in oil analysis, electrical testing, laboratory QA/QC procedures, and compliance with ISO/IEC 17025, ASTM, IEC, and relevant international testing standards.
q: Experience: 6–10 years of relevant experience, with a minimum of 5 years in electrical testing, transformer oil analysis, lubricant oil testing, or a QA/QC testing laboratory.
Education: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
Industry Exposure: Experience in oil testing laboratories, electrical utilities, power generation, industrial maintenance, or condition monitoring services.
Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of transformer oil testing, electrical condition assessment, oil sampling, and interpretation of laboratory test results.
Lubricant Oil Analysis: Knowledge of lubricant oil properties, contamination analysis, wear metal analysis, and machinery condition monitoring.
Standards & Compliance: Working knowledge of ISO/IEC 17025 , relevant ASTM and IEC transformer oil testing methods, and applicable ISO lubricant oil analysis standards.
Laboratory Quality: Experience with QA/QC procedures, equipment calibration, method validation, laboratory documentation, and audit requirements.
Professional Skills: Strong analytical, technical reporting, problem-solving, client communication, and coordination skills.
“Lead the future, start with the best.”
Join Gulf Laboratories – Mannai Corporation and contribute your technical expertise to delivering reliable transformer oil testing, lubricant oil analysis, and laboratory services in Qatar.
r: li
Plan, coordinate, and conduct transformer oil and lubricant oil testing activities in accordance with approved laboratory procedures and international standards.
li
Perform onsite electrical condition assessment testing of transformers, motors, and generators, including oil sampling and technical inspections.
li
Conduct and interpret transformer oil analysis, including dielectric breakdown voltage, moisture content, acidity, dissolved gas analysis (DGA), and other relevant condition monitoring tests.
li
Support lubricant oil testing and condition monitoring, including viscosity, flash point, water content, wear metals, contamination, and oil degradation analysis.
li
Review and interpret laboratory test results, identify equipment condition trends, and prepare detailed technical reports with appropriate recommendations.
li
Ensure laboratory testing activities comply with ISO/IEC 17025 requirements , applicable ASTM, IEC, and ISO testing methods, and established QA/QC procedures.
li
Coordinate with clients and contractors on sampling procedures, onsite testing, technical requirements, and report clarifications.
li
Maintain laboratory equipment calibration, testing accuracy, method validation, quality control records, and compliance with laboratory safety requirements.
li
Support internal audits, proficiency testing, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives related to laboratory quality management.
li
Collaborate with the Oil Laboratory team to improve testing procedures, introduce new analytical methods, and ensure timely delivery of accurate test reports.

d: Our world-class British International School, based in central Doha, is looking for an outstanding Primary Teacher to join us for the start of Spring Term – January 2027. We can't wait to hear from you.
Competitive basic salary plus additional allowances – all tax-free.
Free furnished private accommodation with all utility bills paid.
Free return flights home each year.
Free school places, flights, and medical insurance for children.
Allowances for extra baggage and legal documents.
Comprehensive private medical insurance for Qatar and your home country.
Enhanced end-of-service gratuity package for long servers.
Unlimited sunshine in Qatar – consistently ranked as one of the world’s wealthiest and safest countries!

Our happy, supportive, and tremendously successful Primary team, certified as one of the best in the world by British Schools Overseas, are now looking for an outstanding Primary Teacher to join us for the start of Spring Term (January 2027).
If you are a UK-qualified teacher with experience of delivering the National Curriculum of England – and you have a creative, positive and professional attitude – we would love to hear from you.
q: As part of the Primary team, you will be responsible for planning and delivering the best quality lessons to engage and challenge your students. You will have high standards and expectations in every element of your work.
To Be Considered For a Vacancy, You Should
Hold a good bachelor’s degree and PGCE qualification from a reputable UK university.
Have experience of teaching the English National Curriculum.
Demonstrate good knowledge and understanding of Primary Assessment.
Be keen to develop your career, supported by our world-class professional development.
Genuinely love what you do – showing plenty of enthusiasm, creativity and energy.
Be a real team player, always prepared to go the extra mile and support your colleagues as we reach our goal: to become the best International School in the world.
We can also consider applications from outstanding newly qualified teachers (ECTs), whom we can support through to award of Qualified Teacher Status.
x: QIS is one of the best international schools both in the nation of Qatar and in the wider Middle East region – we are one of a selected number of schools in the world to hold BSO’s ‘Gold Standard’. Our last BSO report (2023) wrote:

Our Primary School – currently comprised of about 1,150 students – is a vibrant, fun and multicultural place of learning. It offers an engaging and warm environment, where children and staff alike are encouraged to investigate and develop their curiosity.

Across each Key Stage, our students enjoy a creative, skills based, and thematic approach to learning. Specialist lessons for Arabic, Islamic Studies, PE, Music, and Library form part of students’ personalised timetables, supporting further our broad and balanced curriculum offer. Our class teachers are highly trained in programmes such as Talk 4 Writing and Read-Write-Inc, which we use to enrich the children’s learning.
